senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: An instrument that makes distant objects appear closer and clearer
To fit events or activities into a shorter period
To slide overlapping sections into or out of each other

ex.en: We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.
ex.zh: 我们在阳台上用望远镜观察月亮。

ex.en: Space telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies without interference from the Earth's atmosphere.
ex.zh: 太空望远镜让科学家能够不受地球大气干扰地研究遥远的星系。

col: look through a telescope｜用望远镜观察
telescope something into｜把某事压缩到
tip: 观星常用telescope；双筒望远镜通常叫binoculars。

senses.en: a building used for worship in certain religions
the flat area on either side of the forehead

ex.en: We removed our shoes before entering the temple.
ex.zh: 我们进入寺庙前脱了鞋。

ex.en: Restoring an ancient temple can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in history and architecture.
ex.zh: 修复古庙既可以保护当地遗产，也能吸引对历史和建筑感兴趣的游客。

tip: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。

senses.en: A word or expression with a particular meaning.
One of the periods into which a school year is divided.
A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.

ex.en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
ex.zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。

ex.en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
ex.zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。

col: in the long term｜从长远来看
tip: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.
Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ex.en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
ex.zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。

ex.en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。

tip: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

senses.en: Feeling extremely afraid.

ex.en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。

ex.en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
ex.zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。

col: terrified at the thought of｜一想到就惊恐
tip: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

senses.en: the main subject or idea in a work or discussion
a recognisable tune associated with a programme or musical work

ex.en: We chose a seaside theme for the birthday party.
ex.zh: 我们为生日聚会选了一个海滨主题。

ex.en: The relationship between economic growth and environmental protection is a central theme in contemporary public debate.
ex.zh: 经济增长与环境保护之间的关系是当代公共讨论的核心主题。

tip: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
ex.zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。

ex.en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。

tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

senses.en: An instrument used to measure temperature.

ex.en: She placed the thermometer gently under her son's tongue.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把体温计放在儿子的舌下。

ex.en: Accurate thermometers help researchers monitor temperature changes in natural habitats affected by global warming.
ex.zh: 精确的温度计帮助研究人员监测受全球变暖影响的自然栖息地的温度变化。

col: read a thermometer｜读取温度计示数
tip: 重音在第二音节；测体温常用take someone's temperature。

senses.en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.

ex.en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。

ex.en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
ex.zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。

col: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品
a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品
a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
ex.zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。

ex.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

tip: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

senses.en: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 雷雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.
ex.zh: 强雷暴会扰乱交通网络并引发突发洪水，排水设施不足的城市尤其如此。

tip: thunder是雷声，lightning是闪电；雷暴用thunderstorm。

senses.en: Time when you are not working or attending school.

ex.en: I need some time off to visit my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我需要请几天假去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Providing paid time off can improve employee wellbeing and reduce stress in the workplace.
ex.zh: 提供带薪休假可以改善员工身心健康，减轻工作压力。

col: time off work｜不上班的时间
tip: 通常不可数；请一天假可说 take a day off。

senses.en: the feeling of needing rest or sleep

ex.en: After the long walk, tiredness made my legs feel heavy.
ex.zh: 走了很长一段路后，我疲惫得双腿发沉。

ex.en: Persistent tiredness can reduce students' concentration and may indicate that they are not getting enough sleep.
ex.zh: 持续的疲劳会降低学生的专注力，也可能表明他们睡眠不足。

tip: 通常不可数；形容人疲倦用tired，事物累人用tiring。

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
ex.zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。

ex.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
ex.zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

senses.en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking
a language used by a particular community

ex.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
ex.zh: 我喝热汤时烫到了舌头。

ex.en: Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.
ex.zh: 用母语接受早期教育的儿童，可能为学习其他语言打下更牢固的基础。

col: stick out your tongue｜伸出舌头
on the tip of your tongue｜话到嘴边却想不起来
tip: tongue指语言多见于mother tongue等搭配。

senses.en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.

ex.en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
ex.zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。

tip: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

senses.en: a competition involving several games between different players or teams

ex.en: Our school tennis tournament starts next Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们学校的网球锦标赛下周六早上开始。

ex.en: Hosting an international tournament can boost tourism, but maintaining sports facilities afterwards may prove expensive.
ex.zh: 举办国际锦标赛能够促进旅游业，但赛后维护体育设施可能费用高昂。

tip: 通常包含多场比赛；单场比赛常用match或game。

senses.en: A path or course for walking, running, or trains.
To follow movement or monitor changes over time.
A mark left by a person, animal, or vehicle.

ex.en: We followed a narrow track through the pine forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过松林。

ex.en: Researchers use satellite technology to track animal movements and identify habitats that require greater protection.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用卫星技术追踪动物活动，并确定需要加强保护的栖息地。

col: keep track of｜持续了解；记录
tip: keep track of指持续掌握；lose track of指失去线索。

senses.en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads

ex.en: The farmer drove a tractor across the muddy field.
ex.zh: 农民开着拖拉机驶过泥泞的田地。

ex.en: Using a tractor allows farmers to cultivate larger areas with less physical effort and fewer workers.
ex.zh: 使用拖拉机使农民能够以更少的体力和人手耕种更大的面积。

tip: tractor是拖拉机；truck是卡车，注意区别。

senses.en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services
to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services
a skilled job, especially one involving practical work

ex.en: At lunch, I traded my apple for a pear.
ex.zh: 午饭时，我用自己的苹果换了一个梨。

ex.en: International trade can create employment, but governments must ensure that workers receive fair wages and adequate protection.
ex.zh: 国际贸易可以创造就业，但政府必须确保工人获得公平的工资和充分的保障。

tip: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。

senses.en: Someone learning the skills needed for a particular job.

ex.en: The trainee watched carefully as the chef chopped vegetables.
ex.zh: 厨师切菜时，那名实习生在一旁仔细观察。

ex.en: Assigning an experienced mentor to each trainee can improve workplace learning and reduce costly mistakes.
ex.zh: 为每位受训人员安排一名经验丰富的导师，可以改善职场学习效果，减少代价高昂的错误。

tip: trainee接受培训；trainer负责培训他人。

senses.en: To express words or writing in another language
To change something into a different form or practical result

ex.en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这份食谱翻译成英语吗？

ex.en: Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 政府必须把环保承诺转化为切实的政策，鼓励企业减少排放。

col: translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

senses.en: The process of expressing meaning in another language.
A spoken or written version in another language.

ex.en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
ex.zh: 这个故事的译文很容易理解。

ex.en: Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.
ex.zh: 准确的翻译使不同国家的研究人员能够分享研究结果，并更有效地合作。

tip: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

senses.en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.

ex.en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
ex.zh: 我们安排了从机场到酒店的接送。

ex.en: Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，让没有汽车的人更容易获得就业机会。

tip: 美式常用transportation，英式通常用transport。

senses.en: Gold, jewels, or other highly valuable objects
Something greatly valued for its beauty, importance, or personal meaning
To value something deeply and care for it

ex.en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
ex.zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。

ex.en: Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存文化珍宝，让后代能够了解早期社会的成就和传统。

tip: 泛指财宝时不可数；指具体珍品时可数。

senses.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury
the way someone behaves towards a person or group
a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance

ex.en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
ex.zh: 经过治疗，她受伤的脚踝感觉好多了。

ex.en: Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的医疗服务，对于缩小富裕社区与弱势社区之间的健康差距至关重要。

tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

senses.en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.

ex.en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。

ex.en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
ex.zh: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。

tip: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

senses.en: An object awarded to someone for winning a competition.
An object kept as evidence or a reminder of victory.

ex.en: Our team lifted the trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 观众欢呼时，我们队举起了奖杯。

ex.en: Although winning a trophy can motivate young athletes, participation should also develop teamwork and personal resilience.
ex.zh: 虽然赢得奖杯可以激励年轻运动员，但参与运动也应培养团队精神和个人韧性。

tip: 复数为trophies；IELTS中主要作名词。

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.
To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
ex.zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。

ex.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。

tip: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。

tip: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

senses.en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern
to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes
to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly

ex.en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
ex.zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。

ex.en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
ex.zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。

tip: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

senses.en: A passage built underground or through a hill.
To dig a passage underground or through something.

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
ex.zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。

ex.en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
ex.zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。

tip: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

senses.en: A large bird often raised for its meat
Meat from a turkey, eaten as food
Something that fails badly, especially a film or play

ex.en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。

ex.en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
ex.zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。

tip: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

senses.en: a place where a road branches off another road
the action of moving around a central point

ex.en: Take the next turning after the small bakery.
ex.zh: 过了那家小面包店，在下一个路口转弯。

ex.en: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
ex.zh: 这个转弯处视野不佳，增加了骑车者和其他道路使用者发生事故的风险。

col: miss a turning｜错过转弯路口
a turning on the left｜左侧的岔路口
tip: 表示岔路口时主要用于英式英语；也是turn的-ing形式。

senses.en: A reptile with a protective shell, often living in water.

ex.en: We watched a turtle swimming slowly over the reef.
ex.zh: 我们看着一只海龟在珊瑚礁上方缓缓游动。

ex.en: Reducing plastic pollution in coastal waters is essential for protecting turtle populations and other marine wildlife.
ex.zh: 减少沿海水域的塑料污染，对保护海龟种群及其他海洋野生动物至关重要。

tip: 英式turtle多指海龟；陆龟通常叫tortoise。

senses.en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups
to teach someone individually or in a small group

ex.en: My tutor helped me understand fractions using paper circles.
ex.zh: 我的辅导老师用圆形纸片帮我理解了分数。

ex.en: A personal tutor can help students develop effective study habits and address specific learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 私人教师可以帮助学生养成有效的学习习惯，并解决具体的学习困难。

col: tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

senses.en: A machine with keys that print characters directly onto paper.

ex.en: My grandfather still uses a typewriter to write short stories.
ex.zh: 我祖父仍然用打字机写短篇故事。

ex.en: Before computers became widespread, the typewriter was an essential tool in offices and newsrooms.
ex.zh: 在电脑普及之前，打字机是办公室和新闻编辑室的必备工具。

tip: typewriter指打字机器，typist指打字员。

senses.en: A person who types, especially as a job.

ex.en: The typist finished the letter before her lunch break.
ex.zh: 打字员在午休前打完了那封信。

ex.en: Although dedicated typist positions are less common today, accurate keyboard skills remain valuable in many workplaces.
ex.zh: 虽然如今专职打字员岗位较少，但准确的键盘输入技能在许多工作场所仍然很有价值。

col: a skilled typist｜熟练的打字员
tip: 指人；typing指打字活动，typewriter指打字机。

senses.en: A rubber covering around a wheel that touches the road.

ex.en: We stopped beside the road to change a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我们在路边停下来，更换一个瘪了的轮胎。

ex.en: Recycling used tyres can reduce landfill waste and provide materials for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收旧轮胎可以减少填埋垃圾，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

tip: tyre是英式拼写，美式拼写为tire。

senses.en: So surprising or unlikely that it is hard to believe.
Extremely good or bad, causing strong surprise.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was unbelievable at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出时山上的景色美得令人难以置信。

ex.en: Some online advertisements promise unbelievable results, making it difficult for consumers to distinguish evidence from exaggeration.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告承诺令人难以置信的效果，使消费者难以区分实证与夸大宣传。

col: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事
tip: 既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。

senses.en: not sure about something
not known, settled, or predictable

ex.en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
ex.zh: 我拿不定主意该买哪件夹克。

ex.en: The long-term effects of remote working remain uncertain, particularly for younger employees entering the labour market.
ex.zh: 远程工作的长期影响仍不明确，对刚进入劳动力市场的年轻员工而言尤其如此。

tip: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

senses.en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase
to show that something is especially important

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to underline the unfamiliar words.
ex.zh: 老师让我们在不熟悉的单词下面画线。

ex.en: These findings underline the importance of providing affordable housing near public transport for families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 这些发现凸显了在公共交通附近为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的重要性。

col: underline a word｜在单词下面画线
underline the importance of｜强调…的重要性
underline the need for｜凸显对…的需要
tip: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

senses.en: Knowledge of something, or sympathy for someone's feelings and situation.
Patient and sympathetic towards other people's feelings or difficulties.
An informal agreement between people or groups.

ex.en: Thanks for your understanding when I arrived late yesterday.
ex.zh: 谢谢你体谅我昨天迟到的事。

ex.en: Learning another language can deepen students' understanding of different cultures and encourage greater respect for others.
ex.zh: 学习另一种语言可以加深学生对不同文化的理解，并促进对他人的尊重。

col: a clear understanding of｜对……的清楚理解
an understanding friend｜善解人意的朋友
tip: 表示“对……的理解”用understanding of。

senses.en: Without a paid job but available for work

ex.en: My neighbour has been unemployed since the factory closed.
ex.zh: 自从工厂关闭后，我的邻居就一直失业。

ex.en: Providing affordable training for unemployed adults can help them develop skills that match changing labour market demands.
ex.zh: 为失业成年人提供负担得起的培训，可以帮助他们掌握符合劳动力市场变化需求的技能。

tip: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。

senses.en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it

ex.en: Watching whales from the boat was an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 在船上看鲸鱼是一次难忘的经历。

ex.en: School trips can provide unforgettable experiences that strengthen students' understanding of history beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校组织的旅行能带来难忘的体验，让学生在课堂之外加深对历史的理解。

tip: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

senses.en: likely to damage physical or mental health
not in good physical condition
harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems

ex.en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
ex.zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。

ex.en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
ex.zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。

col: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食
an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式
tip: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

senses.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind
Found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
ex.zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。

ex.en: Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.
ex.zh: 在日益全球化的世界中，保护地方手工艺有助于社区保留独特的文化认同。

col: unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

senses.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole
a device or separate part of a machine
a group organised for a particular task

ex.en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
ex.zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。

ex.en: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
ex.zh: 这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。

col: a unit of measurement｜计量单位
an intensive care unit｜重症监护病房
tip: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

senses.en: All space and everything that exists within it
A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events

ex.en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。

ex.en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
ex.zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。

col: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙
the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源
tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

senses.en: Not known, identified, or familiar.
Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.

ex.en: An unknown caller rang while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，一个陌生人打来了电话。

ex.en: The long-term effects of some new materials remain unknown, so further research is essential before widespread use.
ex.zh: 某些新材料的长期影响仍不明确，因此在广泛使用前必须进一步研究。

col: unknown to someone｜某人不知道的
tip: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

senses.en: Not expected to happen or be true.
Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

ex.en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
ex.zh: 云层这么黑，今天下午看来不太可能有阳光。

ex.en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 除非服务变得更可靠、票价更实惠，否则公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。

col: unlikely to happen｜不太可能发生
an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友谊
tip: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

senses.en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container
examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts

ex.en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
ex.zh: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。

ex.en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
ex.zh: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。

col: unpack a suitcase｜取出行李箱中的物品
unpack boxes｜打开箱子取出物品
tip: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

senses.en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness.
Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.

ex.en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.
ex.zh: 虽然通勤可能令人不快，但可靠的公共交通能减轻压力，改善上班族的日常体验。

col: an unpleasant experience｜不愉快的经历
unpleasant side effects｜令人难受的副作用
unpleasant to someone｜对某人不友善
tip: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

senses.en: feeling ill or not in good health

ex.en: I felt unwell and went home before lunch.
ex.zh: 我感觉身体不适，午饭前就回家了。

ex.en: Employees who feel unwell should be encouraged to stay home to prevent infections spreading at work.
ex.zh: 应鼓励身体不适的员工居家休息，以防感染在工作场所传播。

tip: 常放在feel或be后作表语，不常放在名词前。

senses.en: to make something current or give someone the latest information
new information or a change that makes something more current

ex.en: Please update your address before we send the parcel.
ex.zh: 请在我们寄出包裹前更新你的地址。

ex.en: Governments should regularly update environmental regulations to reflect scientific discoveries and respond to emerging risks.
ex.zh: 政府应定期更新环境法规，以反映科学发现并应对新出现的风险。

col: update someone on something｜告知某人某事的最新情况
tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈʌpdeɪt/。

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something.
To make someone feel unhappy or worried.
To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.

ex.en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
ex.zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。

ex.en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
ex.zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。

col: upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

senses.en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.

ex.en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过翠绿的山谷。

ex.en: Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.
ex.zh: 河谷中的农业社区依靠季节性降雨维持作物生长，保障当地居民的生计。

tip: valley是两侧山地之间的低地，不等同于盆地basin。

senses.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.
Worth a large amount of money.

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。

ex.en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
ex.zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

tip: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

senses.en: the worth, price, or importance of something
consider something important or estimate how much it is worth
beliefs about what is right and important in life

ex.en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
ex.zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。

ex.en: Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.
ex.zh: 政府应认识到公共公园在改善身体健康和加强社区联系方面的价值。

col: place a high value on｜高度重视
tip: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

senses.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学会做饭后成了一名素食者。

ex.en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。

tip: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

senses.en: A machine used to transport people or goods.
Something used to communicate ideas or achieve a purpose.

ex.en: We left our vehicle outside the small mountain hotel.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了山间小旅馆外面。

ex.en: Electric vehicles can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their electricity comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源发电时。

col: a vehicle for change｜推动变革的工具
tip: 指交通工具时是可数名词，不仅指汽车。

senses.en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms
One person's account of an event

ex.en: The new version of this app loads much faster.
ex.zh: 这个应用的新版本加载快多了。

ex.en: Comparing each witness's version of events helps investigators develop a more accurate understanding of what happened.
ex.zh: 比较各位目击者对事件的叙述，有助于调查人员更准确地了解事情的经过。

col: a version of events｜对事件的一种说法
tip: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。

senses.en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals
to check someone or something carefully before giving approval

ex.en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
ex.zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。

ex.en: Organisations should vet potential employees carefully when recruiting people who will work with children or vulnerable adults.
ex.zh: 组织在招聘将与儿童或弱势成年人接触的人员时，应仔细审查应聘者。

col: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医
tip: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。

senses.en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere
using a particular method, system, or person

ex.en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
ex.zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。

ex.en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
ex.zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。

tip: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

senses.en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells
Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs

ex.en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
ex.zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。

tip: virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。

senses.en: Official permission to enter or stay in a foreign country.

ex.en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
ex.zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。

ex.en: Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.
ex.zh: 简化签证手续可以鼓励国际学生出国留学，并为当地经济作出贡献。

col: apply for a visa｜申请签证
tip: visa是签证，passport是护照；通常需凭护照申请签证。

senses.en: A mountain with an opening that releases lava, ash, and gases

ex.en: We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
ex.zh: 我们望着湖对岸的火山，看蒸汽从山中升起。

ex.en: Although an active volcano can threaten nearby communities, volcanic soils often provide valuable land for agriculture.
ex.zh: 虽然活火山会威胁附近社区，但火山土壤往往能为农业提供宝贵的土地。

tip: 复数volcanoes或volcanos均可；喷发用erupt。

senses.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.
A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.

ex.en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
ex.zh: 我们投票决定在公园里野餐。

ex.en: Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
ex.zh: 允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。

tip: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

senses.en: A document exchangeable for goods, services, or a discount.
A document supporting a payment or accounting entry.

ex.en: I used my gift voucher to buy new shoes.
ex.zh: 我用礼品券买了新鞋。

ex.en: Governments can provide training vouchers to help unemployed adults develop skills required by local employers.
ex.zh: 政府可以提供培训券，帮助失业成年人掌握当地雇主所需的技能。

tip: 常用a voucher for；兑换券用redeem a voucher。

senses.en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.

ex.en: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
ex.zh: 老师把元音拉长，让我们仔细听。

ex.en: Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.
ex.zh: 辨别元音之间的差异有助于语言学习者理解陌生口音，并更清晰地交流。

tip: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

senses.en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week
to carry on a war or organised campaign

ex.en: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。

ex.en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。

tip: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

senses.en: The middle part of your body above your hips.
The part of a garment that fits around your waist.

ex.en: These trousers fit perfectly around my waist now.
ex.zh: 这条裤子的腰围现在正好适合我。

ex.en: Measuring waist size can help health professionals assess certain risks associated with excess body fat.
ex.zh: 测量腰围能帮助医护人员评估与体脂过多相关的某些风险。

col: from the waist up｜从腰部往上
tip: waist指腰，与表示浪费的waste同音。

senses.en: in a friendly and welcoming way
in a way that keeps someone comfortably warm

ex.en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，邻居们微笑着热情地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: When schools welcome new students warmly, they can reduce anxiety and encourage participation in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校热情欢迎新生，有助于减轻他们的焦虑，并鼓励他们参与课堂活动。

tip: greet warmly指热情问候；dress warmly指穿暖和。

senses.en: Water falling from a height over a steep rock face

ex.en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
ex.zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。

ex.en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
ex.zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。

col: the base of a waterfall｜瀑布底部
a cascading waterfall｜飞流而下的瀑布
tip: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

senses.en: Travelling over water on skis while pulled by a boat.

ex.en: We tried waterskiing on the lake last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们在湖上尝试了滑水。

ex.en: Waterskiing can attract tourists to lakeside communities, but motorboats may disturb wildlife and increase water pollution.
ex.zh: 滑水运动能吸引游客前往湖畔社区，但摩托艇可能干扰野生动物并加剧水污染。

tip: 作运动名词时不可数；去滑水用go waterskiing。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area.
Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures.
A film or story about the historical American West.

ex.en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
ex.zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。

ex.en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
ex.zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

tip: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

senses.en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
ex.zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。

ex.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
ex.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

tip: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

senses.en: a cereal crop whose grain is commonly ground into flour

ex.en: Golden wheat swayed in the field behind our house.
ex.zh: 我们屋后的田野里，金黄的小麦随风摇曳。

ex.en: Prolonged droughts can reduce wheat harvests, raising food prices and threatening food security in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 长期干旱会导致小麦减产，推高食品价格，并威胁脆弱地区的粮食安全。

tip: wheat通常不可数；一粒小麦用a grain of wheat。

senses.en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
ex.zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: ready and happy to do something
eager to help or work without needing persuasion

ex.en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
ex.zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。

ex.en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
ex.zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。

col: be willing to do something｜愿意做某事
a willing volunteer｜热心的志愿者
a willing helper｜乐于帮忙的人
tip: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

senses.en: A structure whose wind-driven sails power machinery, often for grinding grain.

ex.en: We watched the old windmill turn beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们看着河边的老风车转动。

ex.en: Restoring a traditional windmill can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in the history of rural technology.
ex.zh: 修复传统风车既能保护当地遗产，也能吸引对乡村技术史感兴趣的游客。

tip: 现代发电风机通常叫wind turbine。

senses.en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.

ex.en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
ex.zh: 一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。

ex.en: A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
ex.zh: 受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。

tip: 英式英语用windscreen，美式英语通常用windshield。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

col: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: Thin metal drawn into strands, often used to carry electricity.
To install or connect electrical wires in something.

ex.en: A thin wire connects the lamp to its battery.
ex.zh: 一根细电线将灯与电池连接起来。

ex.en: Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.
ex.zh: 老建筑往往需要更换电线，以符合现代安全标准并满足增长的用电需求。

col: wire up a house｜给房屋安装电线
tip: wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。

senses.en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.

ex.en: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
ex.zh: 今天带上一件暖和的外套是个明智的决定。

ex.en: It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
ex.zh: 政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。

col: wise to do something｜做某事是明智的
tip: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。

senses.en: a wild animal related to dogs, often living in packs
to eat food very quickly and eagerly

ex.en: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
ex.zh: 一只灰狼静静地站在森林边缘。

ex.en: Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.
ex.zh: 保护狼群有助于控制森林栖息地中的鹿群数量，从而恢复生态平衡。

col: a lone wolf｜独狼；不合群的人
wolf down a meal｜狼吞虎咽地吃饭
tip: 复数为wolves；动词常用wolf down，表示快速吃下。

senses.en: to think about something you do not know
a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
ex.zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。

ex.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
ex.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

senses.en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness

ex.en: After a short workout, I felt ready for breakfast.
ex.zh: 短暂锻炼后，我觉得可以好好吃顿早饭了。

ex.en: A regular workout can improve physical health and help office workers manage stress more effectively.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼可以改善身体健康，并帮助办公室职员更有效地缓解压力。

tip: workout是名词；动词短语work out要分开写。

senses.en: A place where people do their jobs.

ex.en: Our workplace has a quiet room for lunch breaks.
ex.zh: 我们的工作场所有一间安静的房间，供午休使用。

ex.en: Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 营造包容的工作环境有助于员工感到受重视，并促进不同背景的人之间的合作。

tip: 泛指办公室、工厂等工作场所，不等于单指办公室。

senses.en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together.
A room or building where things are made or repaired.

ex.en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
ex.zh: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。

ex.en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
ex.zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。

tip: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。

senses.en: a small animal with a long, soft body and no legs
a harmful computer program that copies itself across networks

ex.en: A worm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
ex.zh: 一条蚯蚓从花园湿润的泥土里蠕动着钻了出来。

ex.en: Worms improve soil quality by breaking down organic matter and allowing air to circulate underground.
ex.zh: 蚯蚓通过分解有机物并使空气在地下流通来改善土壤质量。

col: earthworms and other worms｜蚯蚓及其他蠕虫
a can of worms｜一堆棘手问题
tip: worm泛指蠕虫，earthworm特指蚯蚓。

senses.en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.

ex.en: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
ex.zh: 她的手腕上戴着一条银手链。

ex.en: Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.
ex.zh: 办公室员工应调整键盘位置，减轻长时间使用电脑时手腕承受的压力。

tip: 开头的w不发音；手腕是wrist，脚踝是ankle。

senses.en: Expressed in writing rather than speech.
Past participle of write.

ex.en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
ex.zh: 请把书面说明发来，方便我照着做。

ex.en: Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.
ex.zh: 书面反馈让学生能够回顾错误，并逐步提高表现。

tip: write的变化为write–wrote–written。

senses.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.
An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.

ex.en: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
ex.zh: 等水壶里的水烧开时，我打了两次哈欠。

ex.en: Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
ex.zh: 经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。

tip: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

senses.en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.

ex.en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。

ex.en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
ex.zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。

tip: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

senses.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.
Officially assign land to a particular use.

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
ex.zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。

ex.en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
ex.zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。

col: zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。
